title: What a grape variety is
subtitle: Why the name of the grape tells you so much
objectives: Explain what a grape variety is
Explain how varieties are kept identical
Explain why a variety predicts a style

steps.title: A variety is a recipe
steps.body: A grape variety is a distinct type of vine within Vitis vinifera, with its own berry size, skin thickness, acidity and aromas. Chardonnay, Merlot and Riesling are varieties. Knowing the variety tells you a lot about how the wine will taste before you open it.
steps.highlight: Variety: a type of vine with its own character

steps.title: Cuttings, not seeds
steps.body: A seed from a Chardonnay grape would grow into a new, different vine, because vines don't breed true. So growers plant cuttings, pieces of an existing vine, which are genetically identical to the parent. A Chardonnay vine in Chile is effectively a copy of one in Burgundy. Most vines today are also grafted onto American rootstocks to resist phylloxera, an insect that destroyed Europe's vineyards in the late 1800s.
steps.highlight: Vines are copied by cuttings, not grown from seed

steps.prompt: A vine grown from a Merlot seed will produce Merlot grapes.
steps.explanation: Not true. Vines don't breed true from seed, so the seedling would be a new variety. That's why vineyards are planted with cuttings.

steps.title: Single variety or blend
steps.body: A varietal wine is made mainly from one variety and often names it on the label, like a Chilean Sauvignon Blanc. A blend mixes varieties for balance, like Bordeaux, which combines Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. In the EU and many other places, a wine that names one variety must contain at least 85% of it.
steps.highlight: Varietal labels usually mean at least 85% of that grape

steps.prompt: A Chilean label names only Cabernet Sauvignon. What can you expect?
options: It is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon by law
It is mostly Cabernet Sauvignon, possibly with a little of another grape
It is a blend with no main grape
It is Cabernet grown from seed
steps.explanation: Naming one variety usually means at least 75 to 85% of it, depending on the country. A small share of another grape is allowed.

steps.title: What you learned
points: A variety is a type of vine with its own character
Vines are propagated by cuttings, so each variety stays identical
A varietal wine names the grape that makes up most of it
